shock_quarterly.note: quarterly outcomes are calendar quarters (period end in Q1-Q3); Q1 growth is measured against the same fiscal quarter a year earlier.  The tests are descriptive.

attrition.step: F0. us-gaap facts, project tags, annual filings, consolidated, qtrs 0/4
F1. dropped: reporting currency not USD
F3. dropped: duplicate tag/period, older filing
F4. dropped: flow fact without annual duration (qtrs != 4)
0. flow+balance matched on exact fiscal-year end

clean_ap.definition: direct trade AP or reconstructed residual

tag_sensitivity.definition: full main sample, unscreened; direct vs reconstructed vs contaminated AP; ccc and dpo medians in days
tag_sensitivity.bias: the fallback adds accrued liabilities to trade payables, so it raises DPO and lowers CCC; reconstruction removes the accrual component where the issuer reports it, and the remaining rows are excluded from the clean headline
tag_sensitivity.tag_usage_denominator: share of firm-years in the pre-filter tagged universe that reported any AP tag

preferred_only_ccc_roa.spec: 11. only firm-years using the charter's preferred tag for every input
preferred_only_ccc_roa.note: preferred tag for every input (including a direct trade-AP tag), on the clean-AP sample

attrition_missing_items.item: missing item-cells (sum of the five rows above)

validation.note: internal spot check: panel value vs latest 10-K fact within 7 days of the panel fiscal-year end (companyfacts API). It validates parsing and period alignment for these three issuers, not the tag choice, the fallback order or coverage of the wider panel; unavailable comparisons stay in the denominator
